messages:
Maria (ml): Heads-up — apollox-14b int4 canary is showing a quality regression vs fp16 on our chat-eval suite, plus a few OOMs from canary nodes. Started this thread to triage.
Ajay: saw the logs, looks like fragmentation spike during longer responses. OOM trace: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB (cudamalloc)
  at allocator.cu:124
  kv_cache_alloc -> attempt_resize -> cudamalloc failed
```
Sam: hmm — is this correlated with max_new_tokens? Canary config used 1024. If generation windows hit that, kv grows and we fragment.
Katherine: can confirm, bench run with max_new_tokens=256 had zero OOMs but worse latency. Need to find sweet spot for defaults.
Maria (ml): we want a safe default we can ship for hosted + dedicated. Proposal: max_new_tokens=256, adaptive_batching cap at 2k tokens per batch. Thoughts?
Ajay: agree on lowering default. Also suggest adding a soft cap/pause that backs off batching when mem pressure high. Example quick patch: 
```yaml
model: apollox-14b-int4
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2000
  max_batch_size: 6
memory_policies:
  soft_mem_pct: 0.82  # start shedding batches at 82% GPU mem
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
```
Sam: will run canary with that. Also want to try small slot reserve for KV to reduce fragmentation churn: reserve 32MB aligned blocks on load.
Katherine: run eval suite too — add eval that tracks perplexity + ROUGE for responses and compare to fp16 baseline. Use: `benchmarks-bot run --suite chat-quality --model apollox-14b-int4 --compare apollox-14b-fp16`
benchmarks-bot: queued chat-quality job (id: bq-17912). Estimated 1.2h.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started to 6 nodes with patch (batch cap + max_new_tokens=256). Monitoring logs and memutil.
Sam: quick note — when we quantized, attention kernel swapped to int4 path which increases intermediate buffers by ~10% for certain seq lengths. That plus large batching explains the perf/regression window. We should tune kernel selection thresholds in runtime too.
Ajay: filing a follow-up issue for kernel threshold autotune. Also adding an emergency fallback to fp16 on repeated OOMs for single-request heavy tails.
Maria (ml): thanks. Action items: 1) Sam run canary and post results (perf + eval diff). 2) Ajay add soft mem cap + fallback. 3) Katherine hold off changing prod defaults till bench results. We'll reconvene after bq-17912 completes. :thumbsup:
Katherine: noted. Posting a short eval checklist in #eng-ml later.
Maria (ml): if anyone sees live 500s from canary mark with `tag:apollox-int4-canary` so we can filter traces.
Sam: will post summary in ~1.5h when bench finishes.
